name: sdlc-orchestrator
description: 20-agent SDLC pipeline for Claude Code — Analyst -> PM -> Architect -> Scrum Master -> Coder -> QA -> Reviewer -> Stress -> Tuner -> Verdict -> PR -> DevOps, plus a bug-fix flow, a single-task flow, and standalone security-review/quality-gate/pr-review/release/grill-me/handoff skills. Self-contained, no runtime dependency on any other plugin.
